d:
Enjoy the evergreen romantic hit “Chori Chori Dil Tera Churayenge” from the Bollywood movie Phool Aur Angaar (1993). Featuring Mithun Chakraborty and Shantipriya, this melodious track is beautifully sung by Kumar Sanu and Sadhana Sargam, with music composed by Anand-Milind.
